question: Can a frozen learned RGB backbone plus a reference-trained endpoint-coordinate head recover a complete registered door extent in a separate real rescan?

source_selector.candidate_order: registered stable-door rows ordered by provider OBB area, scan IDs, and instance ID

frame_rules.frame_ranking: visible vertices, visible ratio, projected area, image margin, then earlier frame

partial_reference.description: Train only from the positive-edge quarter of the registered reference endpoint.

complete_reference.description: Train from the complete registered reference endpoint.

learned_field.head: per-reference linear mask-logit plus two-channel canonical portal-coordinate regression
learned_field.decoder: largest probability-mass component, then project the canonical complete reference hull through the learned query coordinate field

allowed: head trained only on the paired reference RGB and registered reference supervision
query_input_contract.note: Forbidden query fields remain evaluator-only and are read only after the RGB prediction is sealed in memory.

stop_rule: Run the frozen single-pair canary once. Do not tune the opened RGB frames, threshold, head, decoder, or gate afterward.
claim_boundary: One real indoor 3RScan stable-door Development canary. A pass would establish only that complete registered reference supervision can be converted into a learned RGB endpoint-coordinate field on one held-out rescan. It does not establish multi-scene generalization, exact physical identity under distractors, doorway aperture, access, traversability, waypoint, arrival, HANDOFF_READY, product benefit, user benefit, or safety.
